name: ModuleListPage XAML
content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<ContentView xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:${Namespace}"
             xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:Floworks.MAUI.Views.Controls"
             x:Class="${Namespace}.${ClassName}Page"
             x:DataType="vm:${ClassName}ViewModel">

    <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,*" RowSpacing="0">

        <!-- Filter bar z action gumbi na levi, filtri na sredini -->
        <controls:StandardFilterBar
            Grid.Row="0"
            FilterDefinitions="{Binding FilterDefinitions}"
            Actions="{Binding ToolbarActions}"
            ApplyFiltersCommand="{Binding ApplyFiltersCommand}"
            ClearFiltersCommand="{Binding ClearFiltersCommand}"
            IsLoading="{Binding IsLoading}" />

        <!-- Tabela -->
        <controls:DataTableView
            Grid.Row="1"
            Columns="{Binding TableColumns}"
            ItemsSource="{Binding FilteredItems}"
            SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedItem, Mode=TwoWay}"
            SortCommand="{Binding SortCommand}"
            SortColumn="{Binding SortColumn}"
            SortAscending="{Binding SortAscending}"
            IsLoading="{Binding IsLoading}"
            EmptyMessage="{Binding EmptyMessage}" />

    </Grid>
</ContentView>

name: DetailOverlay XAML
content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<ContentView xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:${Namespace}"
             x:Class="${Namespace}.${ClassName}DetailsOverlay"
             x:DataType="vm:${ClassName}DetailViewModel"
             IsVisible="False">

    <!-- Zamegljeno ozadje -->
    <Grid>
        <BoxView BackgroundColor="#80000000"
                 InputTransparent="False">
            <BoxView.GestureRecognizers>
                <TapGestureRecognizer Command="{Binding CancelCommand}" />
            </BoxView.GestureRecognizers>
        </BoxView>

        <!-- Panel -->
        <Border BackgroundColor="{DynamicResource SurfaceBackground}"
                Stroke="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}"
                StrokeThickness="1"
                WidthRequest="480"
                HorizontalOptions="End"
                VerticalOptions="Fill"
                Padding="24">
            <Border.StrokeShape><RoundRectangle CornerRadius="12,0,0,12"/></Border.StrokeShape>

            <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" RowSpacing="16">

                <!-- Header -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="0" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">
                    <Label Grid.Column="0"
                           Text="{Binding Title}"
                           FontSize="20" FontAttributes="Bold"
                           TextColor="{DynamicResource TextPrimary}" />
                    <Button Grid.Column="1"
                            Text="✕" Command="{Binding CancelCommand}"
                            BackgroundColor="Transparent"
                            TextColor="{DynamicResource TextSecondary}"
                            FontSize="16" Padding="8,4" />
                </Grid>

                <!-- Polja -->
                <ScrollView Grid.Row="1">
                    <StackLayout Spacing="12">
                        <!-- TODO: dodaj Entry/Picker/DatePicker za vsako polje -->
                        <Label Text="Naziv" FontSize="12"
                               TextColor="{DynamicResource TextSecondary}" />
                        <Entry Placeholder="Vnesite naziv..."
                               BackgroundColor="{DynamicResource Surface}"
                               TextColor="{DynamicResource TextPrimary}"
                               FontSize="14" />
                    </StackLayout>
                </ScrollView>

                <!-- Gumbi -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="2" ColumnDefinitions="*,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
                    <Button Grid.Column="0"
                            Text="Prekliči"
                            Command="{Binding CancelCommand}"
                            BackgroundColor="{DynamicResource SurfaceBackground}"
                            TextColor="{DynamicResource TextSecondary}"
                            BorderColor="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}" BorderWidth="1" />
                    <Button Grid.Column="1"
                            Text="{Binding ModeText}"
                            Command="{Binding SaveCommand}"
                            BackgroundColor="{DynamicResource PrimaryAction}"
                            TextColor="White" FontAttributes="Bold" />
                </Grid>

            </Grid>
        </Border>
    </Grid>
</ContentView>
